title: Activating More Pixels in Image Super-Resolution Transformer
grouping: A two-row grid with one column per method, method names centred above (EDSR, RCAN, SwinIR, HAT (Ours)). The first column holds the reference: the HR image with a small red box marking the patch, and the LR input. Rotated row labels on the left of the method columns name the rows ('LAM Attribution', 'SR Results'); a score is printed under every tile (DI under the attribution maps, PSNR (dB) / SSIM under the results, with those metric names under the first column).
shapes_depth: Borderless square image tiles only. Attribution maps are white with red heat; SR crops carry a green square marking the inspected patch. Plain serif numbers, no arrows or boxes.
proposed_highlight: The proposed method takes the last column, labelled '(Ours)', with its scores in bold; its attribution map is visibly the most widely spread.
lesson: Make the result-idea teaser a two-row grid with one column per method - an attribution heatmap above the output crop, a score printed under each tile - and put your method last with its numbers in bold.
notes: elements 'other' = attribution heatmaps. It is Figure 2 (Figure 1 is a bar chart). Venue not verified here (remembered as CVPR 2023), so venue = arXiv and year = arXiv preprint year. The figure is embedded in the PDF as one raster image, so photo_share is unknown (null) and the palette is measured over the whole raster. Annotation note (2026-11-15): not a method figure: a results/attribution comparison grid (no architecture drawn); architecture set to other (not depicted)

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.note: not a method figure: a results/attribution comparison grid (no architecture drawn); architecture set to other (not depicted)

core.what: one column per method (EDSR, RCAN, SwinIR, HAT (Ours) last) with an attribution map above an SR crop, so the widening red attribution area reads across the row

relations.form: identical tiles in a 2-row x 5-column grid, rows labelled 'LAM Attribution' and 'SR Results' by rotated labels, methods named above, ours last with bold DI and PSNR/SSIM numbers
a red square on the HR image at left marks the analysed patch, and a green box on each SR crop marks the same region
HR and LR inputs in the leftmost column are shared by all methods, with DI and PSNR/SSIM printed under each column

channels.colour: red heat intensity = attribution strength; a red square = the analysed patch; green boxes = the region compared in SR crops; bold text = ours
channels.frame: none; rows and columns are aligned by whitespace and labels

quality.strengths: A textbook alternatives layout: identical tiles, ours in the last column, one metric per row aligned under its tiles, so the visibly larger HAT heatmap and the bold 32.32 / 17.88 read together in seconds.
quality.weaknesses: Red marks both the attribution heat and the patch square on the HR image; the green boxes on the SR crops highlight a region but no enlarged inset shows it, so the quality difference is hard to see at print size.

insights.structure: A two-row grid: HR and LR reference at left, then one column per method (EDSR, RCAN, SwinIR, HAT (Ours)) with LAM attribution maps above and SR crops below.
insights.data: Attribution maps are red heatmaps on white; SR results are real grayscale crops with a green box; DI and PSNR/SSIM are printed under each tile.
insights.emphasis: HAT is the last column, its heatmap is visibly widest, and its numbers are bold.
insights.flow: Left to right across methods; the red square on the HR image marks the patch analysed.

arrangement.units: unframed image tiles in a 2-row x 5-column grid with rotated row labels
arrangement.shared: row labels (LAM Attribution, SR Results) shared across columns
